other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

Paragraphs 7(1) and (2) of Schedule 3 to the National Security Act 2023 provides that the penalty for this offence is the maximum term for summary offences. In relation to an offence committed before the time when section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the 'maximum term' is 6 months and in relation to an offence committed after that time, is 51 weeks.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
